verdict.rationale: Zulip is a team chat product, and AI-generated insights or summaries are a fair axis for that kind of product, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents no built-in AI insights or suggestions. The interactive bot framework is only a developer building block for constructing such a capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
